description: Token Balance History. Calls only GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/token-balance-ts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching wallet token balance history with daily, weekly, or monthly portfolio snapshots and USD valuations over time series.

days.description: Number of previous days to include in the data (from today's date). Allowed values depend on the resolution: - For "1d": 1 to 30 days (default is 14 days) - For "1w": 1 to 90 days (default is 30 days) - For "1mo": 1 to 3

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/token-balance-ts.

resolution.description: Enumeration of supported account time series resolution values for time range or aggregation configuration.

vybeTokenFilter.description: Whether Vybe's token filter should restrict the tokens that are returned. If false, all priced tokens are included. Default is true.

name: get-wallet-token-balance-history
title: Token Balance History
